detail.timelineTitle: Dɔdzikpɔkpɔ ƒe Ɣeyiɣikɔntabubu (ŋɔŋlɔ sia ƒe ŋkɔ ŋɔŋlɔ) .
detail.disputeOpen: Nutɔnyenye ŋuti nyaʋiʋli aɖe ʋu ɖi na asisi sia - hadɔwɔla bubu gblɔ be yewo tɔe. Wotsoa nya me le eŋu le Nyaʋiʋliwo ƒe axaa dzi.

cancellation.title: Wote fli ɖe agbalẽŋɔŋlɔ me
